title: Io at rest · the flash of two eyes

techniques.name: Field-guide plate

fem.label: Specimen
fem.note: Which Io the plate shows: the male, with broad feathered antennae, or the female.

flash.label: Eyespots showing
flash.note: How far the forewings have snapped forward off the hindwings: 0 is the moth at rest, 100 the full startle flash with both eyes out.

scale.label: Scale pitch
scale.note: Pitch of the wing scales, laid in rows about each wing root from the margin inward: smaller lays finer, denser scales; larger lays a coarser, open coat.

grain.label: Paper grain
grain.note: The night stock under the figure, its mottle, fibers and tooth as the page lays them, or a flat ground.

techniques.implementation: A specimen drawn in color on black, with charts and measurements set around it. Drawn by the source page’s own code; its stipple, dots, strokes and stock are given dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
notes: Sources: Claude artifact · How a Moth Works
